cohort: Parturients delivering at a single tertiary center between 2005 and 2014 were included, with 125,768 deliveries analyzed after excluding those with missing blood grouping/hemoglobin values or stillbirth.
finding: Women with O blood type had significantly higher odds of postpartum hemorrhage and statistically significant hemoglobin decreases (>2, 3, or 4 g/dL) compared to women with non-O blood type, but no difference was found in blood product transfusion.
